description.zh: 是否同时删除关联的模板。
description.en: Specifies whether to delete the associated template.
The image IDs. You can specify 1 to 100 image IDs.

description.zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~196646~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表。
description.en: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~196646~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

title.zh: 删除一个或多个自定义镜像

descriptions.zh:
- 镜像分为系统镜像和自定义镜像，其中系统镜像不支持删除。
- 如果镜像已被云电脑模板引用，请先调用[DeleteBundles](~~436972~~)删除对应的云电脑模板。
descriptions.en:
- Images include system images and custom images. System images cannot be deleted.

- If an image that you want to delete is referenced by a cloud computer template, call the [DeleteBundles](~~436972~~) operation to delete the cloud computer template before you delete the image.
